subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d955609426aab07a7588ec1f704a2a78dff730b039b2403e054a27b6c74d9a48.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Number of triangle is decrease by two in every next figure.

2) Number of quadrilateral is increase by one in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03a42127aca74651ef6a8dd7d2bc26add0c168bfb5ae49a9e42f59a1c549df03.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6127b896907470d8225d30baeed2e0fcaf1434f60619fbca92dc8346336166b3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
